text: **Generation 3** is significantly more common in Canada than in the US.
In addition, the side mirrors are blurred out differently: While they generally appear as **two peaks** in Canadian Gen 3 coverage, you will mostly see a single peak in the US.
text_zh: **第 3 世代**在加拿大比在美國普遍得多。
此外，後視鏡的模糊方式也有所不同：加拿大 Gen 3 街景覆蓋中的後視鏡模糊通常會呈現**兩個凸起**，而美國則多半只會看到單個凸起。

text: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only country to have this **low-quality coverage**, known as official ari**, **or “shitcam”.

NOTE: Low quality coverage taken between 2023 and 2025 has especially [low quality](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FRmNSTEtGszBkRqEA). Often you can see huge cars through the blur, and this extremely low quality only appears elsewhere in Lebanon.
text_zh: 在非洲大陸內，奈及利亞目前是唯一擁有這種**低畫質街景覆蓋**的國家，被稱為官方 shitcam，或俗稱「大便相機」。
備註：2023年至2025年間拍攝的低畫質街景具有特別[低畫質](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FRmNSTEtGszBkRqEA)。通常你可以透過模糊看到巨大的車輛，而這種極低的畫質只會在黎巴嫩的其他地方出現。

text: In addition to having less Generation 3 coverage than Canada, the side mirrors are also blurred out differently: While they generally appear as two peaks in Canadian Gen 3 coverage, you will mostly see a **single peak** in the US.
text_zh: 除了第 3 代覆蓋比加拿大少之外，後視鏡的模糊處理方式也不同：加拿大第 3 代覆蓋中的後視鏡通常呈現兩個尖峰的形狀，而在美國你主要會看到**單一尖峰**。

text: Alaska is the only state in the US where **shitcam** **coverage **is prevalent. This coverage is lower resolution with more faded colours, compared to other camera generations. Also, a large blur can be seen at the bottom of the page.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加是美國唯一一個**爛畫質街景覆蓋**普遍存在的州。與其他相機世代相比，這種街景覆蓋解析度較低，顏色也較褪色。此外，頁面底部會看到一個大塊的模糊。

text: **Shitcam** is only found around Anchorage and Fairbanks, and parts of the road that connects them.
NOTE: This map shows all places where this camera can be found. Keep in mind coverage may be updated in some places, therefore you may come across regular coverage in places highlighted here.
text_zh: **爛畫質相機**僅見於安克拉治和費爾班克斯周邊，以及連接兩地的部分路段。
注意：這張地圖顯示了所有可以找到這種相機的地方。請記住，某些地方的街景覆蓋可能會更新，因此你可能會在這些標示出來的地方遇到一般的街景覆蓋。

text: **Shitcam** coverage is found on Ilha de São Miguel and Ilha do Faial.

The car seen on [São Miguel](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JAvRHWSUTF1WN64C8) has an **indentation** in the centre, while the one on [Faial](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SFnsE3SAKAeeX8Pw7) appears as a smooth surface, sometimes with an antenna visible.
text_zh: **爛畫質相機**覆蓋範圍可在聖米格爾島和法亞爾島找到。
在[聖米格爾島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JAvRHWSUTF1WN64C8)看到的車車頂中央有一個**凹槽**，而[法亞爾島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SFnsE3SAKAeeX8Pw7)上的車頂則呈現平滑表面，有時可看到天線。

text: Bangladesh, as well as a variety of other countries, has received some poor quality coverage, also known as “Shitcam”. The Shitcam car colours are [black](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6593897,90.4855596,3a,63.7y,83.56h,57.38t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1pCZPeT5RHbSzl-lSifVeQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [white](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.8892702,90.3897794,3a,63.4y,163.13h,54.23t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-PLvXV5yN94xzegYGmO5TQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).

NOTE: Sometimes the car colour can be fully obstructed by a [big circular blur](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6938128,90.5200604,3a,90y,72.06h,50.06t,0.36r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se3JEcXu6CviGqaDTACJrhw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 孟加拉與其他許多國家一樣，有一些畫質較差的街景覆蓋，也被稱為「Shitcam」。Shitcam 車的顏色有[黑色](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6593897,90.4855596,3a,63.7y,83.56h,57.38t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1pCZPeT5RHbSzl-lSifVeQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)和[白色](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.8892702,90.3897794,3a,63.4y,163.13h,54.23t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-PLvXV5yN94xzegYGmO5TQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。
註：有時車身顏色會被[大圓形模糊](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6938128,90.5200604,3a,90y,72.06h,50.06t,0.36r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se3JEcXu6CviGqaDTACJrhw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)完全遮擋。

text: **Shitcam coverage** is only found in and around Dhaka.
text_zh: **低畫質（Shitcam）街景覆蓋**僅見於 Dhaka 及其周邊地區。

text: You can commonly see a small piece of **grey tape **at the top of the car antenna in Generation 3 coverage. The community sometimes refers to it as “flag antenna”.
Not all Gen 3 coverage has this tape.
NOTE: This can also be seen in Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, and Romania.
text_zh: 在 3 代街景覆蓋中，你經常可以看到車頂天線頂部貼著一小塊**灰色膠帶**。社群有時稱之為「旗幟天線」（flag antenna）。
並非所有的 3 代街景覆蓋都有這種膠帶。
注意：這在捷克、斯洛伐克、匈牙利和羅馬尼亞也能看到。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Cambodia. This camera is known as the official Ari (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Within Asia, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Nepal also have shitcam coverage.
text_zh: Google 在柬埔寨使用了一款奇怪且低品質的相機。這台相機被社群稱為官方 Ari（或「Shitcam」）。它有寬大的圓形車輛模糊，顏色通常有些偏棕色。優質的地圖通常不會包含這種街景覆蓋，但最好了解它的存在，以免被打得猝不及防。
注意：在亞洲，印度、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡和尼泊爾也有 shitcam 街景覆蓋。

text: Shitcam in Cambodia is only found in the **southwestern** half.
text_zh: 柬埔寨的 shitcam 僅出現在**西南**半部。

text: QC-167 and QC-113 are covered in Gen 3 and identifiable for their **overcast autumn** coverage, often with **snow** on the ground. In addition, a [smudge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8TUyRYbPxNvXMX2m9) can be seen on this road.
text_zh: QC-167 與 QC-113 由 Gen 3 覆蓋，其特徵是**陰天的秋季**街景覆蓋，地面上常有**積雪**。此外，這條路上還可以看到[鏡頭污漬](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8TUyRYbPxNvXMX2m9)。

text: The A-31 can be recognised by its **high altitude**, with a **steep drop** into a valley to the north. The road also has Gen 3 sunset coverage.
text_zh: A-31 公路可以透過其**高海拔**來辨認，向北望去有**陡峭下坡**通往山谷。該路段也有第 3 代相機的日落街景覆蓋。

text: Famagusta can easily be recognised by the mostly flat landscape, with lots of red fields. Maybe more importantly though, all of the coverage is **shitcam**.
NOTE: Shitcam is quite rare in the rest of Cyprus.
text_zh: 法馬古斯塔可以透過大致平坦的地貌以及大量紅色田地輕易辨認。不過可能更重要的是，所有的街景覆蓋都是**爛畫質相機**。
注意：Shitcam 在賽普勒斯其他地區相當罕見。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Ecuador. This camera is known as the official Ari (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur and often somewhat brownish colours. You will sometimes see a unique [red logo](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iWqtJ8ZuSgxFhEJ8A) at the front of the car.
NOTE: Within Latin America, Ecuador is the only country that has shitcam coverage.
text_zh: Google 在厄瓜多使用了一款奇怪、低畫質的相機。這款相機被稱為官方的 Ari（或「爛相機」）。它有一個寬闊的環形車身模糊，且顏色通常有點偏棕色。你 parfois 會看到車頭有一個獨特的[紅色標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iWqtJ8ZuSgxFhEJ8A)。
注意：在拉丁美洲內，厄瓜多是唯一擁有爛相機覆蓋的國家。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Finland. This camera is known as the **official Ari** (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur, and can be distinguished from Generation 2 by its lack of a sky halo and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Within Europe, Finland and Spain are the countries that have the most coverage with this camera. This camera should not be confused with unofficial coverage, which is also common in Finland.
text_zh: Google 在芬蘭使用了一種奇怪、低畫質的相機。這款相機被稱為 **官方阿里**（或「爛畫質相機」）。它有一個寬闊的環形車輛模糊處理，並且可以透過缺少天空光暈以及通常帶有些許棕色的色彩與第 2 代區分開來。好的地圖通常不會包含這種覆蓋，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。
註記：在歐洲境內，芬蘭和西班牙是擁有最多這種相機街景的國家。這款相機不應與芬蘭也很常見的非官方街景混淆。

text: Greece is a country with many small islands, some with coverage and some without. Furthermore, while mainland Greece and Crete have all three camera generations, this will not be true for most islands.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 希臘是一個擁有許多小島的國家，有些島嶼有街景覆蓋，有些則沒有。此外，雖然希臘本土和克里特島擁有全部三代相機的街景，但大多數島嶼並非如此。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The vast majority of the coverage in India was taken with what’s commonly referred to as “shitcam”, which is a **low-quality camera** that can typically be recognised by the brownish colours and often, but not always, by a large circular blur covering the Street View car.
NOTE: Within Asia, Nepal is also entirely “shitcam”, while it’s also common in Cambodia and can rarely be seen in Sri Lanka and Bangladesh.
text_zh: 印度絕大多數的街景覆蓋都是用俗稱「爛相機」（shitcam）拍攝的，這是一種**低畫質相機**，通常可藉由偏褐色調，以及經常（但非總是）覆蓋在 Google 車上的大型圓形模糊來辨認。
注意：在亞洲境內，尼泊爾也全都是「爛相機」，柬埔寨也很常見，在斯里蘭卡和孟加拉則較少見。

text: While most of India is covered in shitcam, there is also a significant amount of **Generation 3 trekkers** throughout the country.
text_zh: 雖然印度大部分地區都是爛相機街景，但全國各地也有相當數量的 **Generation 3 徒步拍攝**。

text: The coverage on road NH326 (labelled 326) west of Brahmapur in Odisha has a thin **grey antenna**. The images are generally very high-quality for shitcam, with an especially high quality near the [Harabhangi Reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/haWVM9BU2n4W5T2S7).
text_zh: 奧里薩省布拉馬普爾以西的 NH326 公路（標示為 326）上的街景覆蓋有一個細長**灰色天線**。以爛畫質的標準來說，這些影像通常畫質非常高，特別是在[哈拉邦吉水庫](https://goo.gl/maps/haWVM9BU2n4W5T2S7)附近畫質極高。

text: All of the coverage in Iraq is taken by a **trekker** with a camera similar to **Gen 2 **but with distinctly worse image quality and colour. This coverage tends to be overexposed, even becoming blindingly so [at some points](https://goo.gl/maps/YyzKFREKZvguinm16).
NOTE: This camera quality is sometimes referred to as Gen 1.5.
text_zh: 伊拉克的全數覆蓋都是由**徒步拍攝**所拍攝，其相機類似**第二代**，但畫質與色彩明顯更差。這種覆蓋通常曝光過度，[在某些地方](https://goo.gl/maps/YyzKFREKZvguinm16)甚至刺眼。
注意：這種相機品質有時被稱為 Gen 1.5。

text: Lebanon is currently the only Middle Eastern country that has official **shitcam coverage**.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩目前是唯一擁有官方**爛畫質相機覆蓋（shitcam coverage）**的中東國家。

text: Apart from the shitcam, all of the Lebanese coverage was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker**.
text_zh: 除了爛畫質相機外，所有黎巴嫩的街景覆蓋都是用**第 3 代徒步拍攝**拍攝的。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera on Madeira, commonly known as the official Ari (or "shitcam"). It has a wide circular car blur and makes the image appear rather gloomy. On Madeira, you will often see the unblurred back of a **white** car.
A good map will usually not include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order not to be caught off-guard.
text_zh: Google 在馬德拉使用了一種奇怪、畫質低劣的相機，通常被稱為官方 Ari（或「爛相機」）。它有一個寬闊的圓形車體模糊，讓畫面顯得相當陰暗。在馬德拉，你經常會看到未模糊的**白色**車尾。
好的地圖通常不會包含這種街景覆蓋，但知道它的存在是件好事，以免被打個措手不及。

text: Arvaikheer is a large central town recognizable by the **warm, green, and grassy landscape **in gen 4, with low rolling hills in every direction. Often you can see the town’s [ferris wheel](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RzBqinKz157B8kS19) in a park in the centre of town.

NOTE: In older coverage, a distinct [camera smudge](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) can be seen on the right side of the camera.
text_zh: 科布多爾（Arvaikheer）是個大型的中部城鎮，在第四代相機中以**溫暖、綠意盎然且長滿草的景觀**為特色，四周環繞著低矮的起伏山丘。通常你可以看到城鎮中心公園裡的[摩天輪](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RzBqinKz157B8kS19)。

注意：在較舊的街景覆蓋中，相機右側可以看到明顯的[相機汙漬](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)。

text: All of the road coverage in Nepal was taken with what’s commonly referred to as **“shitcam”**, which is a low-quality camera that can typically be recognised by the brownish colours and often, but not always, by a large circular blur covering the Street View car.
NOTE: Shitcam coverage is also very common in India and can rarely be found in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
text_zh: 尼泊爾的所有街景覆蓋都是用俗稱**「屎鏡」（shitcam）**的相機拍攝的，這是一種畫質低劣的相機，通常可藉由偏褐色調辨識，而且經常（但非總是）伴隨著一個覆蓋住 Google 車的大型圓形模糊。
注意：屎鏡覆蓋在印度也非常常見，在孟加拉和斯里蘭卡則較少見。

text: Generation 4 is not found in the northwest or far south. Shitcam is now found in most of Nigeria.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 相機世代 4 在西北部或極南方找不到。shitcam 現在可以在奈及利亞的大多數地方找到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: If you find yourself in an **arid**, but green, agricultural landscape with an abundance of **corn **around, you are likely to be in Kano state. It is only covered by shitcam, without any Generation 3 or 4.
text_zh: 如果你發現自己身處一個**乾旱**但翠綠的農業景觀中，周圍有大量的**玉米**，你很可能是在卡諾州（Kano state）。這裡僅有 shitcam 覆蓋，沒有任何相機世代 3 或 4。

text: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state. It is almost entirely covered by **shitcam**, and can be recognized by the scattered trees, **reddish soil**, and **dry grass**.
text_zh: 尼日州是貝努埃州的糞畫質（shitcam）同等版本。它幾乎完全被**糞畫質**覆蓋，可以透過零星的樹木、**紅色的土壤**以及**枯草**來辨認。

text: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more **open** and **arid** landscape compared to Niger state. The tree coverage becomes even more sparse, or there may [not be trees at all](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A). These states are entirely covered by shitcam.
text_zh: 貫穿西北部凱比州（Kebbi）、索科托州（Sokoto）、扎姆法拉州（Zamfara）和卡齊納州（Katsina）的高速公路，其景觀與尼日州相比更加**開闊**與**乾旱**，因而可以辨識出來。樹木覆蓋變得更加稀疏，或者可能[完全沒有樹木](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A)。這些州完全被 shitcam 覆蓋。

text: This variant of shitcam with a distinct **blue tint **can be found in these areas.
text_zh: 這種帶有明顯**藍色調**的 shitcam 變體可以在這些區域找到。

text: In Gen 3 coverage, Peru uses a solid **black** or **white** Google car.
NOTE: In South America, these two cars are limited to the following countries:
- The black Google car is only found in Peru, Argentina and Uruguay.
- The white Google car is only found in Peru, Bolivia and Chile.
text_zh: 在第 3 代街景覆蓋中，祕魯使用純**黑色**或**白色**的 Google 車。
注意：在南美洲中，這兩輛車僅限於以下國家：
- 黑色的 Google 車僅見於祕魯、阿根廷和烏拉圭。
- 白色的 Google 車僅見於祕魯、玻利維亞和智利。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Spain. This camera is known as the **official Ari** (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur, and can be distinguished from Generation 2 by its lack of a sky halo and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
text_zh: Google 在西班牙使用過一款奇怪且畫質低劣的相機。這款相機被稱為**官方 Ari**（或「糞便相機 Shitcam」）。它有一個寬大的圓形車輛模糊遮罩，且因為缺乏天空暈光（halo）且通常帶有微紅褐色，可以與第 2 代相機區分開來。好的地圖通常不會包含這種街景，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Sri Lanka. This camera is known as the official Ari (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Other tropical countries with shitcam include India, Cambodia, Ecuador and to a lesser extent Bangladesh.
text_zh: Google 在斯里蘭卡使用了一個奇怪且低品質的相機。這款相機被稱為官方的 Ari（或「爛相機／Shitcam」）。它有著寬大的圓形車輛模糊，且顏色通常有點偏棕色。優秀的地圖通常不會包含這種街景，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。
注意：其他擁有爛相機的熱帶國家包括印度、柬埔寨、厄瓜多，以及程度較輕的孟加拉。

text: All the coverage was taken with a low quality camera that’s commonly referred to as “Shitcam”. The car will often be completely blurred, with a **very large blur** covering the back and a [somewhat smaller blur](https://goo.gl/maps/YfaEf11wuzdt3NYv8) covering the front.

NOTE: The coverage is a newer variant of shitcam, where the image is dimmer and hazier than the original shitcam primarily found in [India](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3MYW94icKvwhWTc66) and [Nigeria](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eETqUgMHvyiCR4di8).
text_zh: 所有的街景覆蓋都是用畫質低劣的相機拍攝的，通常被稱為「爛相機」。車輛經常完全模糊，車尾有**非常大的模糊**遮蓋，車頭則有一個[稍小的模糊](https://goo.gl/maps/YfaEf11wuzdt3NYv8)遮蓋。
注意：此街景是爛相機較新的一種變體，影像比主要在[印度](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3MYW94icKvwhWTc66)和[奈及利亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eETqUgMHvyiCR4di8)發現的原版爛相機還要更暗且更模糊。

text: This desaturated and even dimmer variant of shitcam is most common on Príncipe.
text_zh: 這種去色且更昏暗的爛相機變體在普林西比島上最常見。

text: **Shitcam** can be found in some areas of Vietnam. Notably, the shitcam coverage has a car blur similar to the one from the previous tip, which makes it distinct from other countries where shitcam usually has a larger and more circular blur.
NOTE: The areas in which shitcam can be found will be discussed further at the end of step 2.
text_zh: **爛相機（Shitcam）**可以在越南的一些地區找到。值得注意的是，爛相機的車輛模糊形狀與前一個小提示中的類似，這使它與其他國家（那裡的爛相機通常具有更大且更圓的模糊效果）有所區別。
注意：可以找到 shitcam 的區域將會在步驟 2 的結尾進一步討論。

text: Shitcam is only found in a few spots in the Red River Delta.
text_zh: Shitcam 只在紅河三角洲的幾個地點被發現。

intro.lead: 相機世代決定畫質與可用線索，先判斷再推理
body: 第三代與第四代街景的畫質、車體顯示與模糊處理方式明顯不同。判斷世代能反推拍攝年份與批次，某些國家只有特定世代的覆蓋，這本身就是線索。
低機位（相機架得比一般低）也是這一類的重點，日本、瑞士與斯里蘭卡的部分覆蓋屬於此類。
